stages.name: source-context
operations: Create a separate self-contained Git clone at candidate commit; include its Git objects, never candidate .git pointer or shared .venv.
Copy the archived harness at the publication commit, verify archive hashes and eight-source-file manifest before building.
Use dedicated build context with no credentials, user caches or execution artifacts.

stages.name: dependency-materialization
operations: Preserve frozen universal export and exact Linux/CPython target marker inventory.
Separate eight workspace editables from registry requirements; install registry wheels with hash verification and no source fallback.
If any required compatible wheel is unavailable, report the missing artifact; do not silently compile or change version.
Prepare separate exact build-tools lock because root runtime uv.lock has neither hatchling nor uv-build.

stages.name: isolated-image-install
operations: All installs occur only in the new image environment, never shared .venv.
Install pinned build tools and registry dependencies before eight workspace editables; use no dependency resolution and no build isolation when installing workspace packages.
Iris hatch hook imports iris.version at module load; image-build package execution is not covered by fake runtime checks. Do not build under the current source/fake-only preparation step.
Do not run diagnostic --execute, package import smoke checks, distributed initialization, W&B init or kernels as build validation.

stages.name: artifact-evidence
operations: Record base image/OS/interpreter/installer/build-tools/runtime locks and wheel hashes, full candidate tree identity and harness publication.
Record installed distribution metadata without importing runtime modules; compare against planned closure and source roots.
Record final image digest and source manifest in the future attempt evidence; local metadata alone cannot certify deployed controller or ONLINE/native history.
